author: emegezeta
body:
Hi, Fede, your blog is very interesting. It's a good idea to share with others your experiences with hardware and software troubleshooting and issues.
I will make a link in my blog pointing to yours in "Mis blogs favoritos".
Saludos,
Emegezeta

author: Fed
body:
Thank you, emegezeta. I would have liked to write the blog in Spanish so that my puromac listeners could also learn from the experience, but my skills in writing Spanish are terrible.

I'm going to discuss this story in the next puromac podcast, however.

author: Alex
body: Interesting that the freezing would occur on your new hardware, but not when running on other machines from the same image.  I wonder if it the freezes would have occurred from another account.
